build_InputBlock: build a python module to create an InputBlock that featurizes molecular graph input data into edge and global embeddings
create_atomic_embedding: create an atomic number embedding layer using nn.Embedding with uniform initialization for molecular element representation
create_charge_spin_embedding: create charge and spin embeddings using ChgSpinEmbedding for molecular graph charge and spin feature representation
review_InputBlock_forward: review the InputBlock forward method that computes node embeddings, charge spin embeddings, and neighbor embeddings from GraphAttentionData
test_InputBlock_initialization: test the InputBlock initialization with GlobalConfigs, MolecularGraphConfigs, GraphNeuralNetworksConfigs, and RegularizationConfigs parameters
